OPTIONS & INTEL

AUDIO CONTROLS

Sound Effects (SFX)
Chiptune Synth Music

HUD DISPLAY

Show Shards & Crystals in Combat

When OFF, loot counters stay hidden while you fight — they flash briefly whenever you pick up shards or crystals. Totals are always visible on the pause screen.

TOUCH CONTROLS

• Mobile: Drag your finger anywhere to glide your ship! Auto-fire is always on.
• Finger Offset: The ship glides slightly above your touch so your finger never blocks the action!
• EMP Bomb: Tap the glowing EMP button to blast all enemy bullets into shards!
• Desktop: Mouse drag or WASD/Arrow keys. Space/Click to fire. E for EMP.

NO PAY-TO-WIN PHILOSOPHY

Every upgrade, ship, and power in this game is 100% free and earnable through gameplay. Jump into Endless Arena anytime to farm huge shard jackpots and power up your battle stats!
